tasks.standardized_prompt: Write a Python function to check whether a given integer is a prime number. The function must accept a single non-negative integer n and return True if n is prime and False otherwise. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

Write a Python function to reverse a string without using built-in reverse methods (do not use slicing [::-1] or reversed()). The function must accept a single string s and return the reversed string. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

Write a Python function to convert temperature values across Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. The function must accept a float value and two strings source_unit and target_unit (each being 'C', 'F', or 'K') and return a float rounded to 2 decimal places. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

expected_behavior.function_signature: convert_temperature(value: float, source_unit: str, target_unit: str) -> float

tasks.standardized_prompt: Write a Python function to implement binary search on a sorted list. The function must accept a sorted list of integers arr and a target integer, and return the index of the target in arr, or -1 if not found. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

Write a Python function to parse a CSV file and aggregate numeric data by group. The function must accept a file path string to a CSV file with columns 'group' (string) and 'value' (float), and return a dict mapping each group name to its total summed value rounded to 2 decimal places. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

expected_behavior.normal_cases: CSV with groups A, B, C → dict with summed values

tasks.standardized_prompt: Write a Python class to implement a stack data structure using a linked list (not Python's built-in list). The class must support push(value), pop(), peek(), is_empty(), and size() methods. pop() and peek() should raise IndexError on empty stack. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

Write a Python function to perform breadth-first search (BFS) on a graph represented as an adjacency list. The function must accept a dict graph and a start node and return a list of nodes in BFS traversal order. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

expected_behavior.normal_cases: BFS order from start node, no duplicates

tasks.standardized_prompt: Write a Python function to implement merge sort. The function must accept a list of comparable elements arr and return a new sorted list in ascending order. Include docstring comments documenting the time complexity. Do not include explanations outside the code; provide only the code.

expected_behavior.normal_cases: returns sorted list in ascending order

tasks.standardized_prompt: Write a Python class to implement an inventory management system with full CRUD operations. The class InventoryManager must support: add_item(name, quantity, price), get_item(name) returning a dict or None, update_item(name, quantity=None, price=None) raising KeyError if not found, delete_item(name) raising KeyError if not found, and list_items() returning a list of all item dicts. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

Write a Python class to implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache using a dictionary and collections.deque. The class LRUCache must accept capacity in its constructor and support get(key) returning the value or -1 if absent, and put(key, value) which inserts the key-value pair and evicts the least recently used item if capacity is exceeded. Do not include explanations; provide only the code.

expected_behavior.complexity_expectation: O(1) for get/put (deque.remove is O(n) — acknowledged limitation)
